messages:
Lina Ramos: Heads up - AcmeCorp reported their month-end invoice is ~16% higher than dashboard totals. Invoice shows a 'Pro Plus' token line we don't have on the dashboard. Can someone triage?
Maya Chen: thanks Lina. account id? can you paste the invoice line and dashboard snapshot?
Lina Ramos: Acct: ACME-9182. Invoice line: 'Pro Plus - tokens: 4,512,300 - $2,256.15' Dashboard for Dec 31 shows 3,885,210 tokens on the plan route. Attached CSV from customer.
BillingBot: Automated note: invoice generated 2025-01-01T00:12Z using billing-run v6.3.2.
Arjun Patel: looping finance + eng. Maya — can you confirm whether invoice period cutoff was 00:00 UTC or local? and whether any backfill jobs ran in the 00:00–01:00 window?
Maya Chen: cutoff is 00:00 UTC. I'll check backfill job logs now.
Jasper Nguyen: quick theory: possible double-count from embed backfill that re-ingested tokens but skipped idempotency key. I'll need the raw meter rows for ACME-9182 around 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z.
Maya Chen: pulling meter rows. SQL I ran: ```SELECT account_id, meter_key, sum(tokens) as tokens, min(ts) as first_ts, max(ts) as last_ts FROM meter_events WHERE account_id='ACME-9182' AND ts >= '2024-12-31' AND ts < '2025-01-02' GROUP BY account_id, meter_key;```
Maya Chen: results (summarized): ```account_id | meter_key | tokens
ACME-9182 | text.generate:pro_plus | 4,512,300
ACME-9182 | text.generate:pro_plus | 3,885,210 (duplicate group from earlier window)
```
Priya Singh: that looks like two aggregation windows overlapped. Are those distinct rows or did the query return two shards?
Arjun Patel: can you run with the raw event ids: ```SELECT id, ts, tokens, idempotency_key, source_job FROM meter_events WHERE account_id='ACME-9182' AND meter_key='text.generate:pro_plus' AND ts >= '2024-12-31T23:30:00Z' AND ts < '2025-01-01T01:30:00Z' ORDER BY ts;```
Maya Chen: ran it. snippet: ```id | ts | tokens | idempotency_key | source_job
987654321 | 2025-01-01T00:01:12Z | 1,200,000 | NULL | embed-backfill-2025-01
987654322 | 2025-01-01T00:01:12Z | 2,000,000 | NULL | embed-backfill-2025-01
987654323 | 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z | 712,300 | key-abc123 | ingest-primary
...```
Jasper Nguyen: aha — those embed-backfill rows have NULL idempotency_key and the same timestamps as older ingests; looks like a backfill job re-emitted events without keys. That would make the invoicing job count both.
Eli Turner: oncall note: embed-backfill-2025-01 was a manual recovery triggered by ops for a failed nightly job. It used the legacy emitter by accident. ops already stopped the job at 00:05.
Arjun Patel: confirmation: billing-run v6.3.2 does a distinct aggregation by event ids if idempotency_key is NULL, so duplicates will be counted. Finance: we should mark those tokens as duplicated and credit the customer.
Priya Singh: agreed. What's the total duplicate delta?
Maya Chen: total duplicate tokens for meter_key 'text.generate:pro_plus' = 627,090 (that's invoice - dashboard). matches invoice extra.
Lina Ramos: customer just asked for an ETA on remediation and a credit. I'll draft a response once we have numbers and compensation plan.
Arjun Patel: remediation plan: 1) Apply immediate credit for $2,256.15 pending audit, 2) run a dedupe migration to mark the three embed-backfill meter_event ids as canceled, 3) patch embed-backfill workflow to set idempotency_key and gate via backfill flag, 4) add alert when the same account has >100k tokens duplicated in 10m window.
Jasper Nguyen: technical steps I'll run: ```-- ad-hoc dedupe
UPDATE meter_events SET canceled=true WHERE id IN (987654321,987654322);
-- re-run aggregation
CALL billing.recompute_account('ACME-9182','2024-12-31','2025-01-01');```
Maya Chen: running step 2 now in staging, will schedule prod run after approval.
Arjun Patel: finance: please confirm credit number and GL code. Priya?
Priya Singh: confirm credit for $2,256.15, GL code AR-CRED-EMB, card it to next invoice cycle and notify accounting.
Lina Ramos: messaging to customer: short + transparent. I'll propose: Apology, explain duplicate backfill caused phantom tokens, credit applied, follow-up patch and alert.
Maya Chen: prod dedupe scheduled 2025-01-02T02:00Z, ETA for credit posting 2025-01-03.
Eli Turner: opened incident ticket INC-2025-0123 and assigned to eng-runtime. Also added postmortem task.
Jasper Nguyen: after prod dedupe and recompute, please verify dashboard vs invoice and confirm with customer before closing.
Lina Ramos: thanks all. Maya/Arjun/Priya please ping when credit is posted and I'll close the loop with AcmeCorp. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: will do.
BillingBot: Note: billing adjustment queued: adj-554321 created for ACME-9182 amount -$2,256.15.
